source.title: [Bounty #743] Validate /api/proposals payload before persistence
source.body:
## Problem

POST /api/proposals forwards `req.body` directly to `createProposal` without schema or bounds validation. Any arbitrary JSON object is accepted into the in-memory proposals store, including negative or zero bid amounts, missing cover letters, missing jobId associations, and arbitrary injected fields. Furthermore, unhandled validation errors or malformed payloads can corrupt proposal records and lead to unexpected runtime failures.

## Requested fix

1. Implement a strict Zod validation schema (`createProposalSchema`) in `apps/api/src/validators/proposal.js` enforcing:
   - `jobId`: required string with bounds (1 to 128 characters).
   - `coverLetter`: required string with bounds (min 10 characters, max 5000 characters).
   - `bidAmount`: positive finite number (strictly greater than 0).
   - `estimatedDuration`: optional string with maximum 100 characters.
   - `freelancerId`: optional string with maximum 128 characters.
   - Rejection of unrecognized/arbitrary keys (`.strict()`).
2. Update `apps/api/src/controllers/proposalController.js` (`postProposal`) to parse and validate `req.body` with `createProposalSchema`, returning structured HTTP 400 Bad Request error if validation fails.
3. Add a comprehensive automated test suite (`apps/api/src/tests/proposal.test.js`) using Node's native test runner (`node:test`, `node:assert/strict`) covering:
   - Valid proposal submission (returns 201 with generated proposal id).
   - Rejection of missing jobId (400).
   - Rejection of missing or too short cover letter (400).
   - Rejection of negative or zero bid amount (400).
   - Rejection of unknown extraneous properties (400).

This issue is limited only to the creator of this issue. This means that only the issue author can attempt to solve this issue. If you would like to work on it, please create another issue with the same contents and refer to issue #743 for more information.

This issue is created under the Low Handing Fruit Automation bounty. I will submit a PR that references this issue and issue #743.

/bounty $700
